scope: Conditional single-component algebra; no AC solve or global fuel conservation adjustment.
selection: Explicit requested mean/shape contrasts; no fitted coefficient or scenario selected by residual score.
cohort_representativeness_assumption: Applying a full-calendar EIA mean to qualified hours assumes their mean is representative; no full-month generated-energy claim.

EIA_month_constant.formula: EIA_month_MWh/full_physical_month_hours at each qualified hour; illustrative constant, not measured hourly output.

current_month_mean_constant_shape_ablati.formula: Mean(currentPG on qualified month hours) at each qualified hour; preserves current qualified-month energy, not an EIA source correction.
